observation: Extensionless relative import resolution accepted any path beginning with the import stem plus a dot, so ./foo could fabricate an imports edge to foo.test.js or foo/index.test.js when no real foo source target existed.

pre_fix_reproduction.result: both produced false imports edges from src/main.js

change: Restrict extensionless direct and index fallback matches to a single extension segment. Existing exact-path resolution and deterministic ranking remain unchanged.
truth_boundary: This remains a lightweight relative-import heuristic, not a complete JavaScript/TypeScript/Python/package module resolver.
